title: CubeTwitchChatFB
description: Shows Twitch chat messages from a selected streamer directly in the Minecraft chat. No Twitch API token required. Made by EjectFB
body:
# EjectFB CubeTwitchChatFB

EjectFB CubeTwitchChatFB is a client-side Fabric mod that shows public Twitch chat messages directly in the Minecraft chat.

The mod does not use the Twitch API and does not require an OAuth token. It connects to Twitch chat anonymously and mirrors messages from the selected streamer’s channel into your in-game chat.

## Features

- Shows Twitch chat messages in the Minecraft chat
- No Twitch API token required
- No Streamlabs token required
- Works client-side
- Configurable from Minecraft chat settings
- Message format: `[Twitch: username]: message`
- Purple Twitch prefix and white message text

## How To Use

1. Open Minecraft settings.
2. Go to Chat Settings.
3. Click `Twitch chat`.
4. Enable the mod.
5. Enter the Twitch streamer’s channel name.
6. Press the check button to save.

You can enter either a channel name:

```text
streamername
or a Twitch URL:

https://twitch.tv/streamername
Requirements
Minecraft 1.21.11
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Java 21
Notes
This mod reads public Twitch chat through Twitch IRC/WebSocket. It only displays messages locally in your Minecraft client and does not send Minecraft messages back to Twitch.
```
